_note: Player options (the Options screen), saved per player in user://options.json. Each is an on/off switch with its default ("type": "volume" ones are 0-100 sliders, the game's sound), except "remembered" ones: values the game keeps for the player (not shown on the Options screen).

battle_wait_for_fight.label: Show both squads before a battle and wait for Fight
battle_wait_for_fight.tip: Off: a battle starts playing as soon as it opens.

battle_speed.label: Battle speed
battle_speed.tip: Not on the Options screen: the speed last chosen in a battle (an index into battle.json view speeds), kept for the next battles.

show_daily_ledger.label: Show the day's ledger at noon
show_daily_ledger.tip: Once a day, when income and upkeep are settled, the game pauses and lists the day's gold in and out. Off: a short line in the banner instead.

show_liberations.label: Show a window for each liberation
show_liberations.tip: Off: a banner names the place instead (the window still opens when there's a card to choose).

show_tips.label: Show player tips
show_tips.tip: Short pointers the first time you reach a part of the game (data/tips.json). Each shows once.

tips_seen.label: Player tips seen
tips_seen.tip: Not on the Options screen: the ids of tips already shown, so each shows once.

pause_on_focus_loss.label: Pause when the game window loses focus
pause_on_focus_loss.tip: Switching to another window pauses the map, or the battle if one is playing.
